ValidationRule.description: First Bill Date must not be as past date on Stage 1,2,3,4 or while moving to Stage 5. CloseDate formerly First Bill Date, Booked Date is now First Bill Date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
NOT( $Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR( ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity') ) ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '1 - Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '2 - Solution Developed'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '3 - Solution Agreed'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '4 - Negotiate'), AND(ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'),ISCHANGED( IsClosed )) ),
IM_Booked_Date__c < TODAY(),
$Profile.Name <> 'IM_Sales_IMTN', NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Clari), $Label.IMExpress_Opp_Owner!= OwnerId, NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The First Bill Date can not be a past date when the Opportunity is at stage 1,2,3,4 or while moving to stage 5.
